observations: Photo 0 shows an LG-branded monitor (logo visible on bottom bezel) with screen off/black, sitting on two metal pot/pan-like stands.
Small text at top-left of monitor bezel is present but not legible enough to read a model number.
A dark keyboard with worn/faded key labels sits in front of the monitor.
No power cable, power adapter, VGA/HDMI cable, or remote control is visible in the photo.
Background shows a plastic chair, patterned rug, and what looks like a stick/pole leaning against the wall; no other context.

claims.claim: No dead pixel, no line on the screen
claims.evidence: Screen is off/black in photo 0; a powered-on photo showing a bright image is needed to check for dead pixels or lines.
No remote is visible anywhere in photo 0.
No internal photos or service sticker shown; this cannot be confirmed from outside casing.

risks.risk: Monitor may not power on or may have a faulty panel (dead pixels, lines, backlight issues)
risks.proof: A photo or short video of the monitor powered on and displaying a bright, full-screen image

risks.risk: Missing power adapter/cable and video cable (VGA/HDMI), which are needed to actually use the monitor
risks.proof: A photo showing the power brick and signal cable included with the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as monitor-only, cables not included

risks.risk: Remote control claimed but not shown, may not actually be included
risks.proof: A photo of the physical remote alongside the monitor

risks.risk: Keyboard functionality unknown (keys worn, could have sticking or non-responsive keys)
risks.proof: A short video of the keyboard being typed on with characters appearing on a screen

risks.risk: Listed as 'scrap', suggesting seller themselves considers it non-functional or for parts only
risks.proof: Seller clarification on what 'scrap' means here plus a working demo video

proof_requests: Video of the monitor powered on showing a clear, bright test image (to check for dead pixels/lines)
Photo of the remote control alongside the monitor
Photo of the power adapter and video cable included in the sale
Short video of the keyboard being typed on with visible output
Clarification on why the item is labeled 'scrap' despite claims of no defects
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type and brand (LG monitor plus keyboard), but the seller's own 'scrap' label and the unverified screen/remote/cable claims mean it must be priced at worst case as a non-working, parts-only unit until powered-on proof is provided.
